introBanner: Opened in 2024, Ray's SportsHouse is owned and operated by third-generation Mizzou alumni, the Ray family! We're the home of Mizzou in St. Louis and the best sports destination in the neighborhood. Thank you for joining us; we're glad to see you!
foodDisclaimer: * Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase our risk of foodborne illness.

categories.name: Shareables
categories.tagline: Scratch-made shareable plates, crispy wings, and St. Louis favorites built for the whole table.

items.name: White Bean Dip
items.description: House-made hummus swirled with Calabrian chile oil; served with veggies and grilled naan.

items.name: Street Corn Bruschetta
items.description: Three tall slices of grilled bread spread with ricotta cheese and a fire-roasted corn/onions/poblano peppers blend; drizzled with house made smoked paprika crema.

items.name: Bavarian Pretzels
items.description: 7.5" soft pretzel sticks served with your choice of hatch chile queso or special blend of whole-grain mustard and honey.

items.name: Potato Skins
items.description: Tater boats filled with pimento cheese; topped with crumbled smoked bacon & fresh chives; served with sour cream or ranch.

items.name: Garlic Breaded Cheese Curds
items.description: Inspired by classic cheesy garlic bread; choose from our own Calabrian chile marinara or pesto sauce.

items.name: Buffalo Chicken Empanadas
items.description: Chicken and cheese in a crispy pastry; served with ranch dressing.

items.name: Birria Fries
items.description: Fries loaded with braised beef over hatch chile queso and topped with pickled red onions and fresh jalapeños.

items.name: Toasted Beef Ravioli
items.description: Large round pastas filled with ground beef, spinach and cheese; choose from our own Calabrian chile marinara or pesto sauce.

items.name: Tostadas Trio*
items.description: Seared ahi tuna with avocado, smoked paprika kohlrabi slaw, pineapple pico de gallo made from scratch and fresh jalapeños covering three crispy corn tortillas.

items.name: Chicken Wings
items.description: One pound of wingettes and drumettes; select from Ray's Almost Famous Hot Sauce, Spicy Honey, Carolina Reaper, BBQ, Jerk Seasoning or Lemon Aleppo Pepper; choice of dressing.

categories.name: Salads, Wraps, Sandwiches & Pizza
categories.tagline: Handhelds, wraps, salads, and crispy flatbread pizza. Sandwiches & wraps served with fries.
upgrades: Add two slices of our homemade gold-dusted Billionaire candied & peppered bacon — $4
Upgrade your sides: Cheddar Sour Cream Tots, Cajun Mac & Cheese Bites, or side Garden Salad — $3
Upgrade your sides: Sweet Potato Tots, Battered Onion Petals, or side Caesar Salad — $2

items.name: Crispy Chicken Caesar Salad
items.description: Romaine lettuce tossed in herbed dressing and served with breaded chicken breast, panko and parmesan cheese. (Wrap your salad and add a side for $4)

items.name: BBQ Southwest Chicken Salad
items.description: Romaine lettuce with breaded chicken tossed in BBQ sauce, fire-roasted corn/onions/poblano peppers blend, black beans, tomatoes and cheese blend; served with ranch. (Wrap your salad and add a side for $4)

items.name: Falafel Naan Wrap
items.description: Green chickpea falafel, seedless cucumbers, avocado, grape tomatoes, smoked feta and fresh dill; served with fries.

items.name: Hot Chicken Wrap or Sandwich
items.description: Breaded chicken in Almost Famous Ray's Hot Sauce; ranch kohlrabi slaw, pimento cheese and pickles; served with fries.

items.name: Avocado BLT Wrap or Sandwich
items.description: Avocado, gold-dusted Billionaire Bacon, artisan romaine lettuce and tomato with our house made smoked paprika crema; served with fries. (Add cajun-seasoned roasted turkey or crispy breaded chicken breast for $4)

items.name: Pastrami Reuben Sandwich
items.description: Pastrami, Swiss cheese and sauerkraut with our Everything Sauce on sourdough striped rye; served with fries.

items.name: Smash Burger
items.description: Fresh onions hand smashed into two ground beef patties topped with melted white American cheese, crunchy pickles and Billionaire Bacon; stacked between toasted buns and amplified by our Everything Sauce; served with fries.

items.name: Prosciutto Margherita Flatbread Pizza
items.description: Sun-dried tomatoes, mozzarella pearls, prosciutto and pesto are precisely placed over our own Calabrian chile marinara, topping a natural edge flatbread crust that is baked to crispy perfection.

categories.name: Specialty Cocktails
categories.tagline: Mizzou-inspired house creations, game-day bombs & buckets, and craft pours.

items.name: Jayhawk Tears
items.description: A double shot of Parrot Bay Coconut Rum™ teams up with blue Gatorade, enemy tears, and blue curacao liqueur for a thirst quenching good time. (Bomb $4.99 • 16oz Pint $11.99 • 32oz Bucket $17.99)

items.name: Sarti Spritz
items.description: Sarti Rosa Aperitivo™ pairs with Prosecco for a colorful pink spritz swirling with notes of mango, blood orange, passionfruit, and honeysuckle.

items.name: Black & Gold Reserve
items.description: Yellowstone 93™ bourbon, maple syrup, orange, and bitters come together with a smoky finish for a bold, Missouri-inspired old fashioned worthy of the black and gold.

items.name: Rays of Sunshine
items.description: Kasama™ aged rum blended with pineapple, lime, and a touch of almond, finished with orange bitters for a bright, easy-drinking win.

items.name: Mom's Weekend
items.description: Svedka™ blueberry vodka, riesling, and rosemary make this light, fruity, and dangerously easy to drink.

items.name: Fall Kick-Off Marg
items.description: Cranberry-infused Espolon™ Blanco tequila packs an autumn flavor punch, balanced with fresh lime and triple sec for an unforgettable house-made margarita.

items.name: M-I-Z Bloom Martini
items.description: S.T.I.L.L. Gin™, apricot, and lavender honey bring floral notes balanced with lemon for a crisp, refreshing cocktail that still plays with precision.

items.name: Ray's Espresso Martini
items.description: Cold brew, Hi-Post™ espresso vodka, Kahlua™, and Svedka™ vanilla vodka, blended into a smooth yet slightly sweet coffee cocktail built to keep you going.

categories.name: Craft Mocktails & Beverages
categories.tagline: Zero-proof craft mocktails (with optional spirit add-ons) and fountain refreshments.

items.name: Island Timeout
items.description: Lemonade, raspberry, lime, and cranberry come together for a smooth, fruity mocktail with island sweetness and a refreshing finish. (Add a shot of Bacardi™ Silver Rum or Malibu™ Coconut Rum for $2.99!)

items.name: Z-O-U Sparkler
items.description: Blueberry, lemon, and cranberry topped with limoncello La Croix™ for a crisp, bubbly mocktail. (Add a shot of lemon vodka for $2.99!)

items.name: Soft Drinks, Lemonade, Iced Tea or Coffee
items.description: Pepsi, Diet Pepsi, Dr. Pepper, Diet Dr. Pepper, Mountain Dew, Starry, Mug Root Beer, Lemonade, Iced Tea or Coffee.

categories.name: Drafts, Bottles & Cans
categories.tagline: Ice-cold drafts (including Ray's APA by Schlafly & Boulevard MIZZOU Brew), bottles, and topless-optional cans.

items.name: Ray's APA by Schlafly (Draft)
items.description: Our signature house American Pale Ale brewed in collaboration with St. Louis's own Schlafly Beer.

items.name: Boulevard MIZZOU Brew (Draft)
items.description: Crisp, refreshing game-day lager brewed for Tiger fans.

items.name: Caffeine Creamsicle (Phorm Energy Bomb)

items.name: July Phorth (Phorm Energy Bomb)
items.description: Phorm Energy Screamin' Freedom + Deep Eddy Lemon.
